accountant_is_configured.meaning: the Vault has an Accountant configured

blp_slot_registered_before_call.meaning: an active registration exists for the target BLP slot before the call

supplied_balance_read_succeeded.meaning: a suppliedBalance read for the target BLP slot succeeded
supplied_balance_read_succeeded.checkpoint: at promotion of the pending registration

registration_promoted.meaning: the pending registration for the target BLP slot was promoted to active

total_backing_signed_reverted.meaning: a later totalBackingSigned() call reverted while the entry remained uncleared
total_backing_signed_reverted.checkpoint: later read, before removeSuppliedEntry clears the entry

assumptions: The target BLP slot's registration state is observable as a Boolean before the call.
A suppliedBalance read attempt and its success are observable events for the target slot.

unresolved.description: Report does not state a deterministic trigger for HyperCore leaving the 0x811 slot inactive; the asynchronous-activation premise is conditional.
Timing of the later reverting reads relative to registration promotion is not quantified; only 'later' and 'until removeSuppliedEntry clears it' are stated.

limitations: Impact is potential; the reverting outcome is encoded as a conditional witness, not an inevitable effect.
The three reverting functions are treated as one outcome per the frozen impact statement.
Whether the operator is authorized or permissionless is not encoded; it is not part of the selected P/I/V.
